status: specification — C++ instrumentation pending simulator source code availability
simulator_source_note: The simulator-remodeled/ directory is not present in this repository. Counters must be wired when the source becomes available.

counters.description: Total number of dynamic instruction events emitted during simulation
counters.expected_location: trace-driven: instruction issue or frontend delivery loop
counters.method: Increment counter per dynamic instruction event consumed

counters.description: Number of unique (unique_function_id, pc) pairs encountered
counters.method: std::unordered_set or similar data structure to count unique (function_id, pc) tuples

counters.description: Total number of static info lookups performed (may exceed unique count due to repeated lookups)
counters.method: Increment counter per static info resolution call

counters.description: Total number of threadblocks (CTAs) launched across all kernels
counters.expected_location: trace-driven: threadblock creation / kernel launch path

counters.description: Total number of warp trace objects constructed
counters.method: Increment counter per warp trace object created

counters.description: Number of metadata objects (static info, config records) constructed in frontend
counters.method: Increment counter per metadata object allocation

counters.description: Number of frontend heap allocations (or allocation size in bytes)
counters.expected_location: trace-parser + trace-driven: allocation sites in frontend path
counters.method: Count allocations or track allocated bytes via custom allocator hook

derived_ratios.name: static_reuse_ratio
derived_ratios.interpretation: Average number of dynamic instances per unique static (function_id, pc). Higher values indicate more reuse opportunity for a static-info cache.

derived_ratios.name: tb_metadata_reuse_ratio
derived_ratios.interpretation: Ratio of threadblocks to unique metadata shapes. Values near 1.0 suggest per-threadblock metadata construction dominates (good reuse target). Lower values indicate per-warp or per-instruction metadata paths.

derived_ratios.name: frontend_allocation_density
derived_ratios.interpretation: Allocations per dynamic instruction. Low values suggest allocation amortization is adequate; high values indicate allocation overhead in the frontend hot path.
